label: Communication verbs with addressee
explanation: Fires on speech-act verbs directed at a person — "told/tells/tell" fire on 51–76% of their occurrences, and remind, warn, assure, advise, ask also trigger it — with weak spillover onto the preposition or article introducing the addressee ("told the Senate", "delivered to those"). Strongest on prototypical communication verbs (remind, warn, assure, told); silent on ordinary uses of "to", "the", "of" outside this construction.
